{{Quote|Mmm, There's a place right here|Farmer to Talia|<ref name="Harvest" />}}
A [[human]] '''farmer''' that resided on the agricultural<ref name="Harvest" /> [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]].<ref name="General Store">{{Databank|mina-rau-general-store|Mina-Rau General Store}}</ref> They had dark skin and [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s. In [[4 BBY]], they attended at least one communal gathering between local [[farmer]]s and [[Technician|mechanics]] on Mina-Rau. They ate a meal at the gathering next to [[Brasso]] and another [[Unidentified farmer 2 (Mina-Rau)|farmer]] at long table. While eating they joked around with the fellow attendees. During the gathering, they were bald with a graying [[hair|beard]] and wore a yellow tan [[clothing|shirt]].<ref name="Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
The farmer appeared in the third episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]], "[[Harvest]]", of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[April 22]] [[2025]]. They were portrayed by [[Roger Ajogbe]] in the episode.<ref name="Harvest" />
